title: ruehssia tubularis
intro: Ruehssia tubularis, commonly known as the Chinese rhubarb or Chinese rhubarb root, is a type of flowering plant in the buckwheat family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its role in promoting digestive health and relieving constipation due to its laxative effects. The health benefits of Ruehssia tubularis include its ability to stimulate bowel movements, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinones, such as emodin and aloe-emodin, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including purgation and anti-inflammatory effects.
